evidence: .local/reports/textbox-v2/ (REA decompile JSON: Parse, ParseLua, ParseMarkup, ParseImage, SetLuaParam, ShowDisplayName, ConvertAnyToString; inspect-CreateTextBox.json; disasm/*.s LLVM disassembly of ctor 0x173ae0, Clear 0x1740d0, GUIComponent ctor 0x1681c0, ComponentData::Defaults 0xa2a30, GUIComponent::Update 0x1689b0, GUIComponentTextBox::Update 0x175300, Draw 0x175de0, DrawLine 0x178cb0, TextComponent::ModifyTextBox 0x2be2d0). Earlier CreateTextBox pseudocode: .local/reports/native-text-create-pseudocode.txt. Draw/DrawLine REA decompiles timed out; those conclusions come from disassembly only.

changes_from_v5: Fonts AlegreyaSansSCBold and AlegreyaSansSCRegular admitted. The combat HUD CreateTextBox calls use them.
Each font now carries RemapSize, taken from Game/FontSizes.remap.

The English block of Game/Text/Aliases.sjson is merged in, and InheritFrom records resolve parent-first, then own fields. This makes UI_AmmoText and UI_GunText resolve through UI_SuperText. Three keys conflict and are excluded.
Symbols: the GUI\HUD\Slash and GUI\HUD\InfiniteIcon atlas crops from GUI.pkg are exported (UIR1 RGBA).
resources.build_default_note: build_native.py still defaults to original-text-v5. Staging needs --text-resources .local/native-assets/original-text-v6/manifest.json. With v5, HUD text fails with 'Original font has not been loaded: AlegreyaSansSCBold'.

defaults.OutlineColor: -1 sentinel. Draw clamps RGB to [0,1] and forces alpha 0xFF.
defaults.TextColor: 0xFFFFFFFF via SetTextColor when Color is absent

CreateTextBox_0x2701e0.always: Id resolves to the owner Thing. Scale is clamped to [0,1] (stored at 0x54). RawText wins over Text. Text goes through ShowDisplayName: GetTextData(key)->DisplayName (+0x58), or the key itself if no record exists. Color (GetColor), TooltipKey/TooltipData, LuaKey/LuaValue (SetLuaParam), FadeOpacity (default 0), FadeTarget (1), ScaleModifier (1), ScaleTarget (1).
CreateTextBox_0x2701e0.AutoSet_true: Every argument key goes to ReflectionHelper::SetProperty, and the explicit block is skipped.
both_paths: ShadowOffset (3,3 if present but not a vector2)
CreateTextBox_0x2701e0.not_read_without_AutoSet: ShadowRed/Green/Blue/Alpha, ShadowOffsetX/Y, CharacterFadeTime/Interval. The HUD passes these keys, but the original engine ignores them.

ModifyTextBox_0x2be2d0.ignored_keys_are_native: Other keys, for example the HUD's OffsetY and ColorChangeSpeed, are never read.

update: FadeOpacity steps toward FadeTarget by dt*fadeSpeed. ScaleModifier steps toward ScaleTarget by dt*scaleSpeed. StepTowardColor 0x1ead60 steps each byte channel in [0,1] by speed*dt, clamps, and truncates back to a byte. TextScale() = fontScale * Scale * ScaleModifier (* owner scale only when ScaleWithOwner is set).

parse.lua_params: GetLines 0x17b150 copies mLuaParams (+0xd08) and sets each key as a Lua global (LuaTableExtensions::SetValue). Parse then runs.
parse.markup_dispatch: ParseMarkup 0x17f1c0. '!' -> ParseLua, then appends '@'+value, which re-tokenizes as a ParseImage symbol. '$' -> ParseLua, ConvertAnyToString, then GetTextData(value)->DisplayName (+0x58) or the raw value, re-tokenized via PushTokenizer. '%' -> GetDescription. '^' -> +0x70. '+' -> +0x88. '#' -> ParseFormatting. Word -> IF / control symbol / ParamValue / mParams.
parse.lua_path: ParseLua 0x17cf30: a global, then '.' fields (a numeric field is an integer index). ':P' is a percent format.
parse.number_format: ConvertAnyToString 0x2023d0: an integral double prints as '%d', otherwise '%g'. Booleans print true/false.
parse.image: DrawLine: symbolScale = TextSymbolScale()*data TextSymbolScale. TextSymbolScale() uses FontSize/remapSize (Fonts::GetFont 0x166f71). The pen advances 2 x 0.5 x trunc(w*symbolScale). The sprite is centred, sized w*symbolScale, at the line centre. Its colour is white, with alpha = fade*FadeOpacity.

implemented.markup: Only '{$path}' and '{!path}' are implemented. Every other markup, raw '@', '\\' escapes and '[' overrides fail with 'Original text markup unreconstructed: {...}' or 'Original text token unreconstructed: X'.

approximations_and_unproven: Text alpha still includes the owner's alpha. The OpacityWithOwner default and how Draw consumes it were not traced; the flag is parsed but not used.
Glyph line layout and justification are the earlier portable layout (from DrawInto evidence). Paragraph-wrap equivalence with Parse is not claimed.
Symbol line width for CENTER/RIGHT justification (ParseImage TextureAtlasEntry+0x18) is unresolved. Symbols in justified text fail loudly.
Symbols are admitted only when untrimmed and unscaled, so the atlas entry width equals the texture width.
Outline thickness is not multiplied by TextScale in the renderer. Draw stores TextScale beside it; this was not consumed.
Shadow/outline drawing for inline symbols was not traced; symbols draw plain.
